about_the_game:
A Grand Adventure, A Calm Retreat

  • Explore a floating continent teeming with magical creatures known as MoNs. These creatures love battling alongside the wizards that catch and care for them.

  • Catch magical MoNs, learn powerful spells, and battle other wizards across the continent.

  • An Epic Adventure unfolds as you explore each route and city. Return to your town at any time to plant some crops, harvest some fruit, or relax with the MoNs you've caught! Maybe some NPCs will even move into your town!

The 9 Houses

  • Each House rules over a city and is led by a powerful Archwizard. Each Archwizard uses a unique strategy in battle, built around their signature MoN.

  • Players will travel from city to city, battling wizards and Archwizards along the way. With each victory, players will gain new spells that allow them to unlock new paths and new ways to traverse the floating continent.

  • MoNs can belong to 2 Houses, which will influence their strengths, weaknesses, abilities, and move pool.

The 6 Starter MoNs

  • Monsterpatch features 6 Starter MoNs, and players get to pick 2 to accompany them on their journey! Which 2 will you choose?

Master the Spellbook

  • As a Wizard, you will learn many spells during your adventure! These spells are stored in your Spellbook and can affect nearby objects, MoNs, and the environment around you.

  • Spells can be upgraded after completing certain in-game feats. Some believe there are a handful of secret and very powerful spells that only the best wizards can learn.

Customize Your Town

  • Design your town layout however you'd like. You have complete control over elevation, water, dirt, paths, fences, trees, and much more!

  • Unlock Blueprints for unique structures and town decorations.

  • Every object in the game will be available for you to place in your town, allowing for limitless customization.

  • Recruit Townsfolk to help expand and manage your town. Perhaps you can even gift them MoNs for their own team, and have some friendly battles!

A Fast-Paced Battle System

  • Create a team composition of 4 MoNs that is full of powerful synergies and unique interactions.

  • Grind through the wild with fast-paced encounters. With an adjustable battle speed, players can choose what feels right to them. 

  • Customize the stats, moves, and held item of each MoN on your team. There are tons of strategies to discover, and many ways to express your creativity when it comes to team building.

2 Versions, 1 Game

Monsterpatch comes with 2 versions in the game: Skyfarer Version & Aurora Version!

  • When creating a save file in Monsterpatch, players will be able to choose which version of the game they want to play: Skyfarer version or Aurora version.

short_description: Monsterpatch is a Cozy Monster-Collecting RPG with farming and town building elements. Catch magical MoNs, battle other wizards, harvest crops, and more! There are many treasures to collect, items to craft, and mysteries waiting to be discovered...
